name: Tokyo Tekko Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokyo Tekko Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel and reinforcing bars in Japan. It offers steel bars for concrete reinforcement, including high-tensile threaded and deformed rebars; mechanical joints, such as threaded rebar and mortar-grouted joints; mechanical anchorages, including mechanical anchorage for threaded rebars and shear reinforcement; rebar processing products; and steel exposed column-base method, including SMART-BASE and SCREW-BASE method products. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
